producerSemantics.parts: projector.ts writes call_id=part.id and the complete encoded part (including id) into data; history.withParts prepends data rows in ordinal order to inline content.
producerSemantics.usage: step.started on a reused assistant clears finish/completed but keeps old tokens. step.failed sets completed/error yet replaces tokens only when fresh cost and tokens are both supplied; the stored projection cannot distinguish inherited counters from fresh failed-response usage. Assistant usage therefore requires completed+non-error finish with no error. Compaction terminal rows replace their usage directly.
producerSemantics.zero: session/usage.ts normalizes every absent usage channel to zero; runner/step.ts records those defaults even on a finished step. Every zero channel is ambiguous and remains null, even when other channels are positive. Positive counters remain measured only when the native response state establishes fresh usage.
producerSemantics.cost: session/usage.ts uses provider-reported cost when present and otherwise catalog pricing; the projected cost carries no provenance discriminator.
